p1: In 2009, a serial killer buried a bucket in the Vermont woods. He came back for it two years later.
Inside: weapons... and supplies to get rid of bodies.
His name was Israel Keyes. The FBI called them his murder kits.
He hid them around the country, so they'd be ready whenever he came back.
June 2011. He flew from Alaska to Chicago, rented a car, and drove to Vermont.
He picked a married couple. Total strangers. Chosen at random.
Then he dug up the bucket he had buried two years before... and used it.
He was finally caught in Texas in March 2012, using a stolen debit card.
He admitted to more killings. The FBI believes there were 11 victims.
Some of them have never been identified.
And investigators say the full truth of what he did... may never be known.
